nodes.name: InlineAlert.md

nodes.name: ChatHistory.md
nodes.summary: UI audit of the ChatHistory view (ChatHistoryView.tsx, 523 LOC), a manual fallback review evaluating design-system adherence, arbitrary Tailwind values, hardcoded values, and accessibility as a post-refactor check.

nodes.name: CliVersionAlert.md

nodes.name: webview-memory-findings.md
nodes.summary: Memory audit diagnosing 1GB+ RAM growth in the Tauri webview across session replays, identifying three compounding retention layers (mounted terminals, unevicted replay caches, CSS-hidden keep-alive surfaces) and tracking fixed vs. open items.

nodes.name: REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Open-source readiness audit of the ORGII repository covering secrets exposure, licensing, internal-info leakage, and project hygiene ahead of public release, finding zero blocking security issues.

nodes.name: simulator-app-pattern.md
nodes.summary: Reference guide describing the reusable pattern for adding a new app panel to the ORGII Simulator dock, listing key components/hooks to reuse and the required Rust/TypeScript checklist.

nodes.name: shared-components.md
nodes.summary: Performance audit of shared/design-system components, identifying re-render fan-out issues ranked by severity from high-impact real problems down to premature-optimization nits.

nodes.name: cla-process--0602.md

nodes.name: native-webview-scale-system--0622.md
nodes.summary: Architecture document describing how ORGII scales the main React UI while keeping native inline Tauri WebViews aligned to the visible browser surface, including the measurement flow, shared browser owner flow, and layout-change events.
